name: rq6-test-seeds-posthoc
description:
POST HOC addendum to rq6-test, decided by the author on 2026-11-25 after the final test and
reported apart from it; the final table and its verdict stay as they are. It reads the main
test splits a second time and counts as a second final run. The final model was the config
seed of the union (decision of 2026-10-14). On REDACT dev that seed (0.930) and seed 2 (0.931)
scored below NameTag 3 multilingual (0.935) and seed 1 above it (0.948), and the REDACT test
win was narrow, so this run scores the union's other two seeds beside the config seed and the
opponent, all at this commit: the rules changed after 29 Oct (propagation 046a10a,
birth-number labels 74af0fd, c25b6c0), so the config-seed row is the control here, not the
rq6-test row. Members of each seed as in rq6-candidates-dev. Scored on fobos (NVIDIA L40S),
where the models were trained. No choice depends on it.
